'''Azkul's mercenaries''' were a band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who had gathered together under the leadership of [[Azkul]], a former [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith trooper]] who served under [[Darth Malak]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:Azkul-KOTOR2.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Azkul]], the organization's leader.]]
The group was composed of veterans from both sides of the war, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] alike. During the [[First Jedi Purge]], Azkul brought the group to the [[Grass/Legends|grassy]], strategically-placed yet thinly-populated [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Once there, they accepted a contract with the [[Exchange]] to take over the [[Khoonda]] government by killing [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Terena Adare]] and [[Khoonda Militia]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zherron]]. While they were preparing to attack, a squad, under orders from Azkul, intercepted and captured the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vrook Lamar]], who had gone into the sublevel of the ruined [[Jedi Enclave]].

{{GameLS|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
When the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] freed Lamar from confinement within one of the organization's encampments in the local [[Crystal Cave (Dantooine)|kinrath cave]], the order to attack was given. With the assistance of the Exile and Lamar, however, the [[Battle of Khoonda|mercenary attack]] was unsuccessful, with virtually the entire organization wiped out.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Though the group does not carry an actual name, dialogue with various characters within the computer and video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' makes it clear that the group is under Azkul's undisputed leadership.

If the player, as the Exile, takes the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark path]] throughout the game, then the Exile will instead help Azkul and his mercenaries kill the Administrator and Zherron, ensuring the Exchange's firm control of the planet. Later, a band of mercenaries led by Azkul will show up to aid the Exile against the Sith during the [[Battle of Telos IV]].
